code_label: deal.II (build and run the C++ program)
qoi: convergence order of the error on a fixed probe grid
equation: -div(sigma(u)) = f, with sigma(u) = 2*mu*eps(u) + lambda*tr(eps(u))*I and eps(u) = (grad(u) + grad(u)^T)/2
coefficients: Young's modulus E = 2000, Poisson ratio nu = 1/4, so lambda = 800 and mu = 800
bc_text: u = 0 (all three components) on the entire boundary of the cube
element: Q1 vector elements (trilinear, continuous) on hexahedra, with a quadrature rule of at least degree 3
mesh_text: globally refined uniform meshes of the unit cube with N = 4, 8, 16 cells per side, all three levels
